By the power of a point, for external point \(P\) and a secant through \(A,B\),
\[
\vec{PA}\cdot \vec{PB}=PA\cdot PB=PC^2-r^2.
\]
Here the circle has center \(C(2,0)\) and radius \(r=1\). Since \(P(3,4)\),
\[
PC^2=(3-2)^2+4^2=17.
\]
Thus
\[
\vec{PA}\cdot \vec{PB}=17-1=16.
\]
\[
\boxed{16}
\]
